prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic style, vertical screen, first-person visitor POV. Inside a dimly lit KTV private room, purple and blue neon laser lights flash in the background. An adult Asian woman sits on a black leather sofa, long black hair draped over her shoulders, wearing a black off-shoulder sequined sweater and an exquisite necklace. Initially she looks to the side, then turns toward the camera with a warm playful smile and says, "Hello, you arrived late." The camera smoothly pans down to her silver pointed high heel with diamond-like details. She removes one shoe naturally and lazily while one foot is already barefoot on the reflective floor. Preserve realistic lighting texture and high-definition image quality.
